scope.ledger: 49 completed non-overlapping assessment trades with the archived 5 bp cost convention
scope.method: Direction is sign(score). Long-only and short-only retain the corresponding archived trades and remain flat otherwise.
scope.timing_matched_benchmark: At all 49 archived entry/exit intervals, take a long BTCUSDT position and deduct the same 5 bp cost. The underlying endpoint return is algebraically recovered from the archived costed directional return.
scope.evidential_status: Downstream retrospective attribution only; not an upstream search reconstruction, independent validation, or executable-fill test.

interpretation.raw_tail_asymmetry: The separate 87-trigger audit is long-favouring before non-overlap selection and costs.
interpretation.completed_ledger: Both direction subsets contribute positively in the selected 49-trade ledger; long contributes more, but a pure same-timing long benchmark is near flat and has a deeper drawdown.
interpretation.boundary: This contrast is descriptive and post-selection. It does not establish stable bidirectional predictability or eliminate regime and selection explanations.
